tagline: I look at a coffee leaf, even without internet.
protocol_1: Pick one leaf and lay it on a plain surface (paper, light cloth).
protocol_2: One leaf, well lit, no strong shadow, filling the width of the photo.
protocol_3: Hold the phone steady so the photo is sharp.
guard_intro: I will not give a diagnosis on this photo, because:
guard_busy_background: the background is too busy: lay the leaf on a plain surface
guard_no_leaf: I cannot see the leaf clearly
guard_background_too_colourful: the background is too colourful: lay the leaf on a plain surface
result_medium: Possible, but I am not sure
result_low_body: I am not confident enough to give a diagnosis. Please show this leaf to an agricultural extension officer.
result_medium_warn: This is not a diagnosis. Have an extension officer confirm it before you act.
limits_note: Tested on photos of Arabica leaves laid on a plain background. I only know 4 problems: leaf miner, rust, phoma and cercospora. A “healthy” leaf here does not guarantee the plant is fine.
validate_note: General advice, not yet validated by an agronomist. This tool supports a decision; you and the extension officer make it.
analyzed_in: Analysed on this phone in {ms} ms, without sending your photo.
waiting: {n} observation(s) waiting to be sent. They stay on this phone until you share them.
share_text: Observation of {date}: {label}. Photo attached. (Automatic on-phone analysis, to be confirmed.)
share_unavailable: Sharing is not available on this device: the photo was downloaded, send it by WhatsApp or SMS.
ee_banner: Ewe translations are being validated: text shown in French.
